    return W[f'W_q.{l}'][s]*lw, W[f'W_k.{l}'][s]*lw, W[f'W_v.{l}'][s]*lw, W[f'W_o.{l}'][:,s]

Pout=np.linalg.svd(np.hstack(outs))[0][:,:2]
